multiplicity.method: Holm across all evaluable predictors in the fixed primary family

edge_occurrence_estimand.graph: same spherical k-nearest-neighbour graph as G1
edge_occurrence_estimand.interpretation_of_repeated_occurrence: Monte Carlo edge-opportunity weighting induced by the frozen balanced species/photo schedule
edge_occurrence_estimand.final_grouping: taxonomic species across all retained edge occurrences, not outer-realization occurrence
edge_occurrence_estimand.species_weighting: equal one species-level partial Spearman value per evaluable species

colour_edge_score.observed: same within-outer within-species midrank percentile of four-group Jensen-Shannon edge divergence used by G1
colour_edge_score.null: same score after exact species-conditioned complete-photo colour-vector reassignment for null index 0..998

geographic_distance.metric: great-circle angular distance times Earth radius
geographic_distance.role: ranked covariate partialled from both colour and external scores

resolve_boundary_score.interpolation: spherical linear interpolation on unit Cartesian vectors
resolve_boundary_score.overlap_tie_break: if a sampled point is covered by multiple polygons choose the polygon with the smallest numeric ECO_ID, then smallest numeric BIOME_NUM, then Unicode REALM
resolve_boundary_score.outside_resolve_policy: if any sampled path point is not covered by a RESOLVE terrestrial polygon, that edge has missing external coverage and is excluded; it is never recoded as zero
resolve_boundary_score.adjacent_transition_score: for each adjacent classified sample pair add 3 if REALM differs, add 2 if BIOME_NUM differs, and add 1 if ECO_ID differs; components may add at the same adjacency
resolve_boundary_score.high_value_means: crossing stronger or more numerous established terrestrial biogeographic boundaries

primary_statistic.name: equal-species mean within-species partial Spearman
per_species: rank retained colour-edge scores across all retained scheduled edge occurrences for that species
rank retained RESOLVE boundary scores across the same occurrences
rank retained great-circle distances across the same occurrences
residualize colour rank and boundary rank separately on distance rank with intercept
primary_statistic.global: arithmetic mean of evaluable species partial correlations
secondary_report: fraction of evaluable species with positive partial rho

null_test.p_value: (1 + number of null global mean partial-rho statistics >= observed global mean partial rho) / 1000

computational_equivalence.requirement: streaming/batching must reproduce the mathematical statistic in fcp_pipeline/global_edge_mechanism_v2.py exactly; it may not change edge weights, ranks, species weights, nulls, tail or thresholds
computational_equivalence.memoization_role: speed only; repeated edge occurrences remain repeated in the statistic

claim_if_supported: Within the public-photo inferential frame, stronger within-species flower-colour discontinuities are concordant with stronger established RESOLVE biogeographic-boundary transitions beyond ranked great-circle distance under the frozen species-conditioned colour null. This is concordance, not evidence that the classification itself caused colour evolution or proof of local adaptation.
